# Carson Farmer

> Personal link-in-bio site for Carson Farmer — engineering and R&D executive, cofounder & CTO, working on AI strategy, architecture, evaluation, and distributed systems.

Carson is a hands-on engineering and R&D leader and former professor, working on AI strategy and architecture, AI evaluation, developer platforms, and distributed systems. Based in Victoria, BC, Canada.
